{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Emerald green silk midi dress, bias cut to drape fluidly over the curves, floor-skimming length, rich emerald with hex code #50C878, lightweight silk.
Gold metal ankle cuffs, thin band width, calf-high length, warm antique gold with hex code #B8860B, polished gold-tone metal.
Nude satin pumps, pointed toe silhouette, knee-high length, soft nude with hex code #F5D0B9, smooth satin fabric.

This ensemble is perfect for an autumn festive dinner because the emerald silk captures the rich tones of the season while offering an elegant silhouette that flatters every shape. The gold cuffs add a touch of celebratory sparkle appropriate for evening lighting without being overpowering, and they draw attention to the legs beautifully on parquet floors. Nude satin pumps elongate the figure and maintain a sophisticated balance between comfort and high fashion for a formal occasion."}
